review.notes: Independent package review with the adversarial pass (Claude, claude-VoV5d9, issue #10281); accepted with fixes. Part boundary: all 810 nonblank lines of the original §§5.12–5.22 are present. The split had reduced 'Throughout this assertion' lines to bare fragments: 65 repeats were deleted and 7 folded into sentences. The de Jong and global-field paragraphs of the supporting block are stated in full in Part VII and were removed here. Cross-part links go only to Parts I, IV, V and VII (395 links, all resolve); no target uses AnalyticNumberTheory directly; nothing feeds back into it, into an earlier part or into ModularityAndLanglandsExtensions. Front matter rewritten for this part, with supplier contracts per supplier as Uses (upstream sections) and Required in addition, checked against the current upstream READMEs of IG #850, AS #849, GN #851, EDC #1040, DWP #929 and SchemeAndStackFoundations. The moment estimate, the large-q Cohen–Lenstra theorem and its corollary are marked conditional on (HS). Duplication against upstream IG and current Tau Ceti: only coprime complements (IG §IG.4.5) was stated upstream, and that target was narrowed to the count [H : H^Γ]. Garbled references fixed (comparisonST.0 /16, items /132 and /133, dangling Part II and Layer pointers); 22 duplicate Checks removed; spurious italics escaped. Sources: scripted sweep of about 110 locators, plus reading of EVW pp.769, 774–782, Wood pp.18–25 and 33–34, LT pp.31–37, BLS pp.52–59, Achter–Pries pp.7 and 11–14, Vasiu p.2, LWZB pp.3–4; all correct. The SL2(Z/9) witness was recomputed: order 24, bijective onto SL2(F3), index 27. Adversarial table in reviews/REV-PKG-ArithmeticStatisticsPartVIII~adv.md. Lean grew from 61 to 227 lines: similitude cosets on Matrix.J, odd-degree densities, allowed prime powers with the eventual-degree predicate, and the parity multidegree count with its stars-and-bars theorem; negative controls; three decide examples. lean-check exits 0 at Mathlib 082e2d3 / Tau Ceti f790474 with 24 warnings, all proof placeholders, and no errors. check_sorry_data passes; data definitions are axiom-clean; intake check-files reports 0 problems.
